blocks.en: Industry is a catch-all term for all the industrial activities within EVE: mining, gas huffing, manufacturing, researching, invention, reprocessing, and reverse engineering.
blocks.zh: 工业（Industry）是 EVE 中所有工业活动的统称，包括采矿、采集气云、制造、研究、发明、提炼和逆向工程。

blocks.en: Industry is vitally important to the EVE economy and activity, as without industrial-minded players building the ships and modules and ammunition required for PvE and PvP combat, combat-minded players could not function. Virtually none of these items are seeded on the market; almost everything in EVE is player-built (you can identify NPC sell orders on the market by their >300 day duration).
blocks.zh: 工业对 EVE 的经济和各类活动至关重要。如果没有热衷工业的玩家去建造 PvE 和 PvP 战斗所需的舰船、装备和弹药，战斗型玩家就无从施展。这些物品几乎都不是系统投放到市场上的；EVE 里几乎一切都是玩家造的（市场上 NPC 的卖单可以通过其 >300 天的期限来识别）。

blocks.en: Industry can be roughly split to two aspects: Acquiring materials for production and producing items from materials.
blocks.zh: 工业大致可以分为两个方面：获取生产所需的材料，以及用材料生产物品。

blocks.en: This page shows you a general introduction industry. For further details on mining, manufacturing, research, invention and other aspects of industry, see the links in the box to the right.
blocks.zh: 本页对工业做一个总体介绍。关于采矿、制造、研究、发明及工业其他方面的详细内容，请参阅右侧方框中的链接。

blocks.en: Production refers to everything you can do with a blueprint in the Industry window: manufacturing of items, time efficiency and material efficiency research of blueprints, blueprint copying, invention, and reverse engineering. Production is a vital part of the EVE Online economy, and can be carried out in any security space, in any station with the appropriate facilities or in an Upwell structure with the necessary service modules.
blocks.zh: 生产指的是你在工业窗口里用蓝图能做的一切：制造物品、蓝图的时间效率和材料效率研究、蓝图拷贝、发明以及逆向工程。生产是 EVE Online 经济的重要组成部分，可以在任何安全等级的星系进行，地点可以是任何具备相应设施的空间站，或装有所需服务装备的昇威建筑。

en: Blueprints are the base of production in EVE. They can be directly used for T1 production, researched to make them better for T1 production, copied or used for invention for T2 production.
Manufacturing You have a blueprint or a blueprint copy. The next step is to manufacture the item.
Research allows improving the material efficiency or time efficiency of a T1 blueprint original. This allows you to make the item with fewer materials or in less time.
Copying is the process of making limited run copies off of a blueprint original. The copies retain the ME and TE research level of the original blueprint.
Invention is the process of making T2 blueprint copies off of a T1 blueprint copy.
Tech 3 Production is the process of making tech 3 ships.
Reactions is the process of refining raw moon ore or gas into a form that can be used for manufacturing.
zh: 蓝图是 EVE 中生产的基础。蓝图可以直接用于 T1 生产，也可以通过研究提升 T1 生产效果，还可以拷贝，或用于发明以进行 T2 生产。
制造：你手上有了蓝图原件或蓝图拷贝，下一步就是制造物品。
研究可以提升 T1 蓝图原件的材料效率或时间效率，让你用更少的材料或更短的时间造出物品。
拷贝是从蓝图原件复制出有限流程次数的蓝图拷贝的过程。拷贝会保留原件的材料效率和时间效率研究等级。
发明是用 T1 蓝图拷贝做出 T2 蓝图拷贝的过程。
T3 生产是制造 T3 舰船的过程。
反应是把未加工的卫星矿石或气云精炼成可用于制造的形态的过程。

blocks.en: The industry window can be found in the neocom menu. This is the window that is mainly used for industry.
blocks.zh: 工业窗口可以在Neocom菜单中找到，这是从事工业时主要使用的窗口。

blocks.en: In the Blueprints tab you can see your and your corporation currently owned blueprints, either originals (BPO) or copies (BPC), in any location. Use the drop-down boxes to view corp blueprints, or blueprints in other locations. Click the column headers to sort by that column. Faded-out blueprints are ones currently being used in a job. The cog in the top left of this section will let you show/hide blueprints that are currently in use. Note that with very large blueprint collections the blueprint list may simply fail to load.
blocks.zh: 在蓝图标签页中，你可以看到自己和军团目前拥有的、位于任何地点的蓝图，包括原件（BPO）和拷贝（BPC）。用下拉框可以查看军团蓝图或其他地点的蓝图。点击列标题可按该列排序。颜色变淡的蓝图表示正在被某项任务占用。本区域左上角的齿轮可以显示/隐藏正在使用中的蓝图。注意，蓝图数量非常多时，列表可能会直接加载失败。

blocks.en: The Facilities tab gives you an overview of the industrial facilities available to you, both stations and upwell structures. Each of the activity icons has a red bar along the bottom of the it. This shows the System Cost Index, which can be expanded by mouseover. The system cost index is a rough indication to how much your job will cost, relatively, to install. The more of the icon is filled with the red bar, the more of that activity is being carried out in that facility, and thus the more expensive the production lines will cost.
blocks.zh: 设施标签页概览了你可用的工业设施，包括空间站和昇威建筑。每个活动图标底部都有一条红色进度条，表示星系成本指数，鼠标悬停可展开查看。星系成本指数大致反映了你安装任务的相对费用。图标被红条填充得越多，说明该设施里进行这项活动的人越多，生产线的费用也就越高。

blocks.en: Only facilities within your region or an adjacent region will populate in the window. Facilities more than one region away, even if they may be both within skill range and closer than other facilities, will not show up. A facility being available in the industry window only shows access to the relevant services and does not guarantee docking rights.
blocks.zh: 窗口里只会列出你所在星域或相邻星域内的设施。相隔超过一个星域的设施，即使在技能范围内、甚至比其他设施更近，也不会显示。某个设施出现在工业窗口中，只表示你能使用相关服务，并不保证你有停靠权限。

blocks.en: In Jobs tab you can view all of your and your currently-running jobs, plus their duration, end time, location, activity and similar useful things. Research jobs have blue duration bars, manufacturing jobs have yellow bars. You can also see jobs installed by people in your corporation, so long as they are using corporation-owned blueprints. You will need to use this tab to deliver completed jobs back to your hangar.
blocks.zh: 在任务标签页中，你可以查看自己所有正在进行的任务，以及它们的时长、结束时间、地点、活动类型等有用信息。研究任务的时长条为蓝色，制造任务为黄色。只要军团成员使用的是军团所有的蓝图，你也能看到他们安装的任务。完成的任务需要在这个标签页里交付回你的机库。

blocks.en: All manufacturing requires materials to be obtained to use in the production process, and there are various sources of raw materials in New Eden that require harvesting, in order to gather these resources.
blocks.zh: 所有制造都需要先获得生产过程中使用的材料。新伊甸有多种原材料来源，需要通过采集来收集这些资源。

en: Mining is the profession of extracting ore and ice from asteroids; these can then be reprocessed into minerals that are the basis of virtually all production in EVE.

Moon mining is a special type of mining. Moon mining requires an engineering complex to break off chunks of a moon for mining. The high investment on the structure and potential threat on it means this is often an activity for a group of players. Moons are a vitally important source of raw materials for all T2 products, and some T1 products. To use the materials mined from the moon for anything they need to be refined through reactions first.

Gas cloud harvesting is another specialized form of resource gathering. The clouds found in low security space are used for medical boosters while the gas from wormholes is used for tech 3 ship production.

Salvaging is finding useful items from wrecks. Any ship wreck in EVE Online can be salvaged to retrieve salvage materials. Salvage from normal wrecks is used for manufacturing rigs. Salvage retrieved from Sleeper wrecks on the other hand is used for manufacturing tech 3 ships.

Planetary Industry is the process of extracting useful materials from planets. Planetary Industry is an excellent source of passive income that can be managed remotely requiring physical interaction only for hauling products off the planet.

Reprocessing is the process by which mined ore (and almost any item) can be turned into minerals. Various skills, different POS facilities, and station taxes will affect how much material is returned to you from reprocessing. It may not be profitable for you to reprocess some things if your skills are fairly low. Reprocessing is also used to decompress compressed ores.

There are various sources of rarely used yet required items. These can be bought from NPC sell orders or found in specific sites. Dealing with them may be a bottleneck for a player trying to produce goods but also a high margin market for someone who knows where to look. Notable items include:
zh: 采矿是从小行星中开采矿石和冰矿的职业；这些矿石可以提炼成矿物，而矿物几乎是 EVE 中所有生产的基础。
卫星采矿是一种特殊的采矿。卫星采矿需要一座工程复合体把卫星的碎块炸下来供开采。由于建筑投入很高，且可能面临威胁，这通常是一群玩家共同进行的活动。卫星是所有 T2 产品和部分 T1 产品极其重要的原材料来源。从卫星开采的材料要先经过反应精炼，才能派上用场。
气云采集是另一种专门的资源采集方式。低安的气云用于制造医疗增效剂，而虫洞中的气云用于生产 T3 舰船。
打捞是从残骸中找出有用物品。EVE Online 中任何舰船残骸都可以打捞以获取打捞材料。普通残骸的打捞物用于制造改装件，而从冬眠者残骸打捞到的材料则用于制造 T3 舰船。
行星开发是从行星上提取有用材料的过程。行星开发是极好的被动收入来源，可以远程管理，只有把产品从行星运出时才需要亲自操作。
提炼是把开采的矿石（以及几乎任何物品）转化为矿物的过程。各种技能、不同的 POS 设施以及空间站税率都会影响提炼的产出量。如果你的技能还比较低，提炼某些东西可能并不划算。提炼也用于解压缩已压缩的矿石。
还有各种很少用到却必不可少的物品。它们可以从 NPC 卖单购买，或在特定站点中找到。对想生产商品的玩家来说，搞定这些物品可能是个瓶颈；但对知道去哪儿找的人来说，这也是个高利润的市场。值得一提的物品包括：
